build_rlu_locomotion_dataset: build the RluLocomotion dataset builder for offline RL benchmarks with humanoid and rodent tasks
create_features_dict: create the features dictionary defining observation, action, reward, and metadata schema for rlu_locomotion episodes

summarize_rlu_locomotion_dataset: summarize the rlu_locomotion dataset description and citation for offline reinforcement learning benchmarks
